text:
incident-bot: Pager: SEV2 - metering pipeline emitted tokens delta > 15% vs baseline for eu1 03:12 UTC. Possible KV cache mismatch. Auto-snooze 5m.

 taylor: ack oncall I'm looking

 taylor: quick check: are we seeing overage flags for customers?

 sara: seeing ~1200 overage flag emails queued from notif service, mostly small customers

 miguel: logs show emitter shard eu1-03 reported duplicate KV flush at 03:11:42

 taylor: paste logs

 miguel: ```
 2026-03-19T03:11:42Z emitter[europe-03] INFO kvcache: prefix_flush id=shard-eu1-03 seq=128374 dup=true
 2026-03-19T03:11:42Z metering OUT tokens=+487134 window=60s
 ```

 taylor: hm dup=true suggests double-counting when cache flushed during windowing. Could explain token bump + overage alerts

 kpeters: @billing-bot can you confirm whether billing emits to ledger were duplicated?

 billing-bot: Verified: ledger received two emit batches with identical id=shard-eu1-03:128374 at 03:11:42 and 03:11:44. Second marked processed; shadow reconciliation shows +0.98x counted

 sara: customer-impact: ~42 customers hit soft overage thresholds; 3 customers got hard overage emails

 taylor: mitigation: temporarily disable prefix_flush auto-retry on emitter shards eu1-03, set dedupe window 5m, and pause outbound notification queue for billing-alerts

 taylor: commands:
 ```bash
 # disable auto retry
 curl -XPOST https://ops-api/emitters/eu1-03/config -d '{"auto_retry":false}'
 # set dedupe window
 curl -XPOST https://ops-api/emitters/eu1-03/config -d '{"dedupe_window_s":300}'
 ```

 miguel: making change now

 miguel: changed, restarting emitter process

 taylor: billing team - we'll treat these counts as suspect until recon. Please hold billing writes for affected window and annotate ledger with provisional flag

 kpeters: billing team acknowledged, holding writes for 03:10-03:13 UTC

 sara: notif queue paused, clearing immediate emails backlog

 taylor: monitoring metrics: token delta trending back to baseline at 03:20

 billing-bot: shadow reconciliation in progress; preliminary suggests refund windows for 3 affected customers may be needed

 taylor: plan: continue hold until full recon; open postmortem with RCA pointing to KV cache retry logic, rollout patch to emitter by EOD, customers notified by CS once recon done

 sara: noted, I'll draft customer comms and tag @cs to review

 miguel: logs + trace ids saved to /var/logs/incidents/1719234567 for postmortem

 taylor: thanks all. moving to watch mode. will update when recon completes

 incident-bot: Incident moved to watch-state by taylor at 2026-03-19T03:25:00Z
